scoring_justification: The task produces DFT-calculated exchange constants and ab initio D parameters, which are compared to the paper's reported theoretical values with generous 50% relative tolerance. Full recompute of DFT is infeasible in the checker, so result-level compare is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold J1..J4 and |D_Co| values for comparison
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 (DFT row for Ni) and discussion text (Co ab initio values)
hidden_assets.generation_method: copied directly from the published paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact theoretical values reported in the paper's Table 2 and text; they constitute the ground truth for this computational reproduction.

outputs.description: Exchange coupling constants (cm⁻¹). Must have correct signs (J2 negative) and order-of-magnitude agreement with the paper's DFT values.
Magnitudes of single-ion axial anisotropy (cm⁻¹). Order of magnitude should match the paper's ab initio results.

output_contract.notes: This task reproduces the theoretical calculations only (DFT exchange couplings and ab initio anisotropy) as reported in the paper. Experimental magnetic data fitting is not required. The agent must install a suitable quantum chemistry package (e.g., ORCA) and may require substantial computational resources.
